policy: Disclosure-safe outward-rounded WAS wealth support bounds for the UK support gate, generated from the donor household tab recorded under source.tab_sha256 by tools/build_uk_was_wealth_support_bounds.py. Values are donor-realized exact ranges rounded outward to one significant figure, so unit-record minima and maxima are never committed.

source.sdc_treatment: Exact donor min/max values are rounded outward to one significant figure before commit, so no committed number is an exact unit-record value. Caveat considered and accepted: WAS applies top-coding and a round top-code can survive outward rounding unchanged; top-codes are published survey methodology rather than unit-record disclosures. Adjudicated acceptable under the UKDS EUL disclosure rules by juaristi22 on 2026-08-19 (microcosm#714).

chronicle: Support bounds generated from the tab pinned as source.tab_sha256 (18b3eb980c02…) with outward SDC rounding.
